summary: Correctly moves use_required_attribute logic to FileInput so required is suppressed when initial data exists, matching the issue request. Adding an identical override to ClearableFileInput is redundant since it now inherits the same method from FileInput, but this is a trivial nit and does not block merge.

issues.description: ClearableFileInput.use_required_attribute is now an exact duplicate of the inherited FileInput.use_required_attribute and can be removed; the issue only asked to move it to the FileInput base class.
